title: Remodeler AI Discovery — High-Ticket Ops
notes: Sentence-level lines. Each line is one spoken phrase with a sequential id; `phase` groups lines visually. Only `raw` is stored: `body` with annotations stripped is derived, so the fixture cannot drift from the cue parser.

lines.label: Carve the time
lines.raw: Hey [Name], appreciate you carving out the time.

lines.label: Not pitching
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] Just to set the stage, I'm not here to pitch you today.

lines.label: Learn the firm
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] I really just want to learn how the firm operates day-to-day.

lines.label: Prototype promise
lines.raw: If I see a clear way AI can save you hours or add revenue, I'll build a live prototype for you to see next time.

lines.label: Straight talk
lines.raw: If not, I'll tell you straight and we part ways.

lines.label: Sound fair
lines.raw: [⏸️ 1s] Sound fair? [🤔 CURIOUS]

lines.label: Typical day
lines.raw: So starting from a bird's-eye view, walk me through a typical day.

lines.label: Personal time drain
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] Out of everything you do, what's eating up most of your personal time right now? [🤔 CURIOUS]

lines.label: New jobs in
lines.raw: Makes sense. Looking at the front end, how are new jobs actually coming in right now?

lines.label: Past project photos
lines.raw: [⏸️ 1s] And all those photos of your past projects—what happens to those, do they mostly just sit there? [🤔 CURIOUS]

lines.label: Lead calls on site
lines.raw: Got it. Now, what happens when a new lead calls while you're busy on a job site?

lines.label: Tire-kickers
lines.raw: [⏸️ 1s] How much time do you think you waste calling back or driving out to tire-kickers who don't even have the budget? [🤔 CURIOUS]

lines.label: Weekly admin
lines.raw: Okay, and once a client is actually signed, what's the most repetitive, annoying computer work you or the team have to deal with every week? [🤔 CURIOUS]

lines.label: Picture of ops
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Okay, I've got a really good picture of how things run.

lines.label: Not the bottleneck
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] Honestly [Name], your actual trade work isn't the bottleneck at all.

lines.label: Three leaks
lines.raw: Looking at your workflow, you have three specific operational leaks:

lines.label: Leak 1: catch leads
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] First, the delay in catching leads when you're busy on site.

lines.label: Leak 2: referrals
lines.raw: Second, relying on referrals instead of turning your past projects into automated Google reviews.

lines.label: Leak 3: admin bleed
lines.raw: And third, that evening admin bleed.

lines.label: 15k on the table
lines.raw: [⏸️ 1.5s] If you add those up, you're easily leaving $15k on the table every month.

lines.label: Diagnosis check
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] [⏸️ 2s] Does that diagnosis feel spot-on to you? [🤔 CURIOUS]

lines.label: Decision authority
lines.raw: Got it. Quick question—when you look at fixing operations like this, is that 100% your call, or do you have a business partner who weighs in? [🤔 CURIOUS]

lines.label: Pace up
lines.raw: [⚡ PACE UP] Awesome.

lines.label: No generic PDFs
lines.raw: Well, I don't like guessing and I don't send generic PDFs.

lines.label: Build the prototype
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] I'm going to take these exact notes and spend the next 24 hours building a custom, live AI prototype so you can actually test it with your own hands.

lines.label: Lock the time
lines.raw: [⬇️ DOWN] Are you in front of your computer tomorrow around 14:30, or is Thursday at 15:00 better? [⬇️ DOWN]
